methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Prove and implement all first-order binary-character rank cuts on the actual generated lattice H/2H, with an eight-call unequal-class example passing rational rank cuts and determinant equality but violating a parity cut.
scope_change_reason: The live PR2900/2934 handoff asks for an unequal-class candidate screened before scalar search. This session supplies a missing necessary screen and a precise separation, not another construction or a covered finite-group census.
bottleneck_link: Additional dirty roles cannot escape this rank cut. Rejecting a frame multiset before choosing scalar couplings prevents an invalid larger-register search; this is a pre-search result, not an improving supplier.
stop_rule: Stop after one complete necessary-character screen, exact separating example and behavioral verification. Do not search scalar words or expand a construction family.
evidence: README.md proves the character inequality and coverage. RESULT.json records an eight-call 1<3 rejection, 28 independent six-frame subsets, target determinants 400/256/152, a direct nine-call positive word and 5676 Cramer/gcd/primitive-relation oracle cases. Six behavioral groups include actual CLI and semantic implementation mutants.
